text: Siskin-8 listens on port 4272; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.

Unlike Siskin-8, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Shrike-3 is the Tessera team. Nobody should assume the owner of Shrike-3 applies to Siskin-8, the owner differs. An older draft of this note was archived.
Pages from Shrike-3 land on the pager rotation of Celia Zielinski before anyone else. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
Questions about Curlew-7 start with its owner, the Sprocket team; they triage anything filed against it.
Unlike Curlew-7, whose port is handled elsewhere, the port of Kestrel-4 is 4911. Nobody should assume the port of Kestrel-4 applies to Curlew-7, the port differs.
Curlew-7 listens on port 7515; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules.
Teal-7 is implemented in Haskell; the language was chosen for its tooling.

Unlike Teal-7, whose pager rotation is handled elsewhere, the pager rotation of Kestrel-4 is Elena Dunmore. Nobody should assume the pager rotation of Kestrel-4 applies to Teal-7, the pager rotation differs.

Unlike Curlew-7, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Ibis-7 is the Lattice team. Nobody should assume the owner of Ibis-7 applies to Curlew-7, the owner differs. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Finance fixed the budget of Shrike-3 at $2590k, reviewed every quarter. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.

Unlike Kestrel-4, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Ibis-7 is April 5, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Ibis-7 applies to Kestrel-4, the retirement date differs.

The owner of Kestrel-4 is the Prism team, and every change to Kestrel-4 goes through their review. Details change slowly, so check the history first.

Unlike Curlew-7, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Teal-7 is the Quill team. Nobody should assume the owner of Teal-7 applies to Curlew-7, the owner differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
The pager rotation for Teal-7 is run by Elena Pemberton; alerts page them first.

The yearly budget for Kestrel-4 is $4185k, covering licences and hosting.
Curlew-7 was granted a budget of $1875k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over. An older draft of this note was archived.
Plan around the retirement date of Kestrel-4: April 4, 2027 is when it goes dark. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
The yearly budget for Teal-7 is $1200k, covering licences and hosting.
Siskin-8 enforces a rate limit of 4200 requests per minute per caller.

Expect throttling at the rate limit for Curlew-7, which is 1100 requests per minute.
